senses.gloss: m. (cmp. sericum) [of Seres, Chinese,] silk. Targ. II Esth. V, 1; VI, 10, v. פְּרַנְגַּן.—
units: Keth. 63ᵇ הוה תפיסא חד שירא (Rashi חדא ש׳) she seized a silk garment (Rashi: a cloak).—Pl. שִׁירָאִין, שִׁירָיִין, שִׁירָאֵי.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Ezekiel 27:19">Targ. Ez. XXVII, 19</cite> <he>בשיריין</he> ed. Lag. (oth. ed. <he>בשִׁירִין</he>, corr. acc.).—
Sabb. 90ᵃ תכך דש׳ the worm (tʿkhakh) in silk garments.
<cite ref="Kiddushin 32a:7">Kidd. 32ᵃ</cite> <he>קרע ש׳ וכ׳</he> tore silk garments in the presence of his son Rabbah (to test his filial respect).
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 6:2:16">Y. Sabb. VI, 8ᵇ</cite> bot. (expl. <cite ref="U01948"><he>שֵׁרוֹת</he></cite>, <cite ref="Isaiah 3:19">Is. III, 19</cite>) <he>שיראין</he> silk cloaks (?).
